items.title: Race for the Case Action Boards
items.summary: This action sequence follows characters Zero and Dallas as they attempt to steal back a precious diamond on a moving train.

items.title: Mothman and the Light Comedy Sequence
items.summary: This comedy sequence follows a bored little girl as she attempts to sneak Mothman into her home and past her Grandma. However, Mothman begins to eat every light source throughout the home.

items.title: Drama Board Sequence
items.summary: Script and characters provided by professors. Follows an older samurai as he travels to take a young girl back to her family.
